envelope.description: REPO_TRACKER_FIELDS table, branchPattern grammar and repoFields in the catalog

body.title: REPO_TRACKER_FIELDS table, branchPattern grammar and repoFields in the catalog
body.summary: Add the single REPO_TRACKER_FIELDS table next to CONFIG_CATALOG with local, status and policy rows (one policy row per TeamPolicy rule), the value validators, and the branchPattern grammar on its row (placeholders {id}, {slug}, {type} only, allowed characters, length and structural rules). Expose the definitions as the static repoFields field of buildSettingsCatalog, which stays pure and total.
acceptanceChecks: Keys are unique, every local key is a GithubEntry field and there is one policy row per TeamPolicy rule
buildSettingsCatalog keeps every existing field unchanged, adds repoFields and never throws
The branchPattern validator accepts and rejects exactly the forms in the LLD, each rejection naming the failing rule
A test copy of the table with an added placeholder changes what the validator accepts with no other change

src/config/__tests__/repo-fields.test.ts: a table copy with another placeholder changes what the validator accepts
